observed_failure: The candidate identified the correct values, years, scope, formula and evidence but returned a legacy rich calculation object; the v0.9 schema rejected it before deterministic calculation.
changes: For deterministic_calculation, the model root contains only calculation_request.
For percentage_change, calculation_request contains only operation and two period_year-value-evidence_handle observations.
Task id, subject, scope, requested period, formula, rounding and direction remain framework-owned and are not model fields.
For controlled_conflict, the model root contains only source_claims; task id, subject, scope and period remain framework-owned.
The system prompt states the exact minimal shapes for calculation and conflict tasks.
unchanged_rules: The framework validates numeric values and years against selected evidence.

The framework derives conflict state only after source and value grounding.
No failed output is repaired or reused as a passing result.
All six tasks restart under the new exact hashes before P2 eligibility.
